tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends a land survey quote request to Roome Land Surveying, a licensed land surveying firm in Plano, Texas, with the details the person gives. Properties in Texas only. Nothing reaches Roome until the person confirms the request from an email Roome sends them. Quotes are free.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The land surveying services Roome Land Surveying offers, each with its slug for request_quote and its page on roomeinc.com.

tools.name: service_area
tools.description: Whether Roome Land Surveying serves a Texas county or city, from the service area on roomeinc.com.

tools.name: which_survey
tools.description: Which of Roome Land Surveying's services fits a person's situation, best match first, with each service's common uses and who it's for. Use it when someone doesn't know which survey they need.

tools.name: what_to_expect
tools.description: What happens when you ask Roome Land Surveying for a survey: the free quote, how long a survey usually takes, the survey day, and paying. Give a service slug to add what you receive and the steps for that survey.

tools.name: contact_details
tools.description: Roome Land Surveying's phone, office hours, office and mailing addresses, and which email to use for quotes, billing or anything else.
